name: GetYouTubeTranscript
summary: YouTube transcripts in any caption language the video has, YouTube search, and channel, playlist and video data.

api_key.description: a GetYouTubeTranscript API key (sk_live_..., from getyoutubetranscript.com/developers). Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: Billed in credits: 1 per successful call, failed calls and /credits are free. A new account gets 100 free credits.
Batch transcript jobs (POST /batch) and agent self-signup are in the API but not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get a video transcript
endpoints.summary: Full transcript for one video, plus title/author/thumbnail metadata.

v.description: YouTube video URL (full or short) or an 11-character video ID.

timestamps.description: Set to 'true' to include 'segments': per-line {start, duration, text} timestamps in seconds, e.g. for citing a moment in the video.

translate.description: Language code to machine-translate the transcript into, e.g. 'es', 'de', 'zh-CN'.

notes: 1 credit per successful call; a failed call (no captions, private or removed video) costs nothing.
Text comes from the captions the video already has; a video with captions turned off has no transcript. timestamps=true adds per-line segments with start and duration in seconds.

endpoints.name: List a video's caption languages
endpoints.summary: The caption languages a video offers, creator-uploaded ('manual') and YouTube speech recognition ('auto'), so you can pick one before calling /transcript.

v.description: YouTube video URL (full or short) or an 11-character video ID.

notes: 1 credit per successful call; failed calls are free.

page_token.description: Short opaque cursor (data.continuation_token) from the previous page.

notes: 1 credit per successful call; failed calls are free.
Paged: pass data.continuation_token from the previous response as page_token to get the next page; each page is a separate 1-credit call.
